verdict.rationale: Finix's docs show disputes can be monitored and acted on through the Dashboard or API, including uploading evidence and submitting a response. That covers the evidence-submission part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows chargebacks being attributed to the correct sub-merchant or seller, or dispute outcomes automatically adjusting seller balances. Missing for 10: evidence of per-seller/sub-merchant dispute attribution, automatic flow of dispute outcomes into seller balances, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, disputes are managed per seller — chargebacks land against the right sub-merchant, evidence is submitted via API or dashboard, and outcomes flow back into seller balances automatically

citations.quote: Monitor and act on Disputes through the Finix Dashboard or API.
Upload evidence and submit a response to challenge a Dispute.
